description: DIN 580 lifting eye bolt: a threaded shank, a collar, and a forged circular lifting eye (a torus) integral on top, as one connected solid. The eye inner/outer diameters (DIN 580 d2/d3) and the thread length (l) are the tabulated values for the nominal thread size; the shank carries a modelled external metric thread (revolved sawtooth, flush ends). The collar is proportional to the thread size.
source: DIN 580 dimension table (d2 eye inner, d3 eye outer, l thread length) per nominal thread size; ISO 261 coarse pitch
